text:
RunSignUp reports 47 age-group winners at Terre Haute races in July 2026
By
F. B. LittleA total of 47 age-group-winning results were recorded at races held in Terre Haute, Indiana, during July 2026, according to RunSignUp. These victories came from two parent races: Pacesetter Sports Presents: The Mile and Riddell National Bank Presents: The Twilight River Run.
Victories were distributed among four events, with 25 in the Womens Mile - Run, 15 in the 5K Runners, four in the 1 Mile, and three in The Mile - Walk Only.
